Rarity.rationale: Matches RegalPillow.cs:15. In the transcribed shared grab bag as Common (relic_pools.py:125), executed by `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b13.py pool`.

CanonicalVars.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the port now pins the constant. `RegalPillow.HEAL = 15` (sts2_rl/relics/regal_pillow.py:22) is `new HealVar(15m)` (RegalPillow.cs:17), and modify_rest_site_heal_amount returns `amount + self.HEAL` (regal_pillow.py:24-25) = `amount + DynamicVars.Heal.BaseValue` (RegalPillow.cs:25). No AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension appears in the C# file, so 15 is the whole non-ascension value. WAS: the port carried no constant at all because it implemented nothing.

ModifyRestSiteHealAmount.maps_to: modify_rest_site_heal_amount (sts2_rl/relics/regal_pillow.py:24-25), declared on the base at sts2_rl/relics/base.py:306-311 and folded over run.relics by RunState.rest_site_heal_amount (sts2_rl/run.py:350-359)
ModifyRestSiteHealAmount.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the hook exists and is dispatched. `Relic.modify_rest_site_heal_amount(run, amount)` is declared on the base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:306-311) and RunState.rest_site_heal_amount (sts2_rl/run.py:350-359) now folds it over every relic in the run on top of the `max_hp * 3 // 10` base, which is Hook.ModifyRestSiteHealAmount over GetBaseHealAmount (HealRestSiteOption.cs:60-63, 90-93) and covers MendRestSiteOption.cs:58 through the same helper. Regal Pillow implements it as `amount + 15` (sts2_rl/relics/regal_pillow.py:22-25 = RegalPillow.cs:19-26). WAS: RunState.rest_site_heal_amount was a bare `max_hp * 3 // 10` with no hook loop and `Relic` declared no modify_rest_site_heal_amount member, so a rest with the relic healed 24 where C# healed 39.

AfterRestSiteHeal.maps_to: after_rest_site_heal (relics/base.py) exists and RunState.rest_heal dispatches it (run.py:1094), but the port does not implement it
AfterRestSiteHeal.rationale: RegalPillow.cs:28-37's entire body is `Flash()` and `base.Status = RelicStatus.Normal` after the owner check -- pure presentation. Waived under the shared contract's presentation exclusion, NOT as unported content. This matters as a correction: sweep C's work list names `AfterRestSiteHeal` and `AfterRoomEntered` as this relic's dropped hooks with live sim dispatch sites, and both are presentation-only in the source, so implementing either would change nothing. The hook that actually needs porting is ModifyRestSiteHealAmount, which has no sim base method at all -- reported in .superpowers/sdd/relic-batch-13-lessons.md.

ModifyExtraRestSiteHealText.rationale: RegalPillow.cs:39-54 appends `base.AdditionalRestSiteHealText` to the rest-site option's description string, gated on `LocalContext.IsMe(base.Owner)` (a multiplayer local-view check). Localisation text and multiplayer view scoping are both out of scope under the shared contract. Sweep C already excludes ModifyExtraRestSiteHealText from its 33 actionable dropped hooks on the grounds that it needs a new base hook; here it is verdicted on its own merits as presentation.

AfterRoomEntered.maps_to: after_room_entered (relics/base.py) exists but the port does not implement it
AfterRoomEntered.rationale: RegalPillow.cs:56-60's whole body is `base.Status = (room is RestSiteRoom) ? Active : Normal` -- the relic bar's greyed/active state. Presentation, waived under the shared contract's exclusion. Same correction note as AfterRestSiteHeal above.

Regal Pillow implements it as `amount + 15` (sts2_rl/relics/regal_pillow.py:22-25 = RegalPillow.cs:19-26). guards.what: N1: the port's stated premise -- 'an out-of-combat rest-site effect, so this is a no-op stub' (regal_pillow.py:8-9)
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the stub is gone. sts2_rl/relics/regal_pillow.py now implements modify_rest_site_heal_amount (:24-25) and its docstring (:8-16) cites HealRestSiteOption.cs:60-63/90-93 and MendRestSiteOption.cs:58 instead of claiming the sim has no rest site. The one hook the premise said was absent -- Hook.ModifyRestSiteHealAmount -- is declared at sts2_rl/relics/base.py:306-311 and dispatched by RunState.rest_site_heal_amount (sts2_rl/run.py:350-359).

guards.what: N2: `creature.Player != base.Owner && creature.PetOwner != base.Owner` (RegalPillow.cs:21-24) -- the heal hook is per-CREATURE, not per-player
guards.rationale: The PetOwner clause exists so a player's PET is healed by its owner's Regal Pillow. The sim has no pet creatures at a rest site at all -- RunState.rest_heal heals the run's single HP pool -- and pets are event-relic content (Relic.adds_pet exists for Pael's Legion's gate, relics/base.py:89-91, but no pet creature is modelled). Waived as a multiplayer/pet-scope omission rather than filed as a gap because the divergent thing is which creatures exist, not what the relic does; a fix for G1 that adds +15 to the run's single heal is complete for the sim's scope. Recorded so a future pet port revisits it.

guards.what: N3: the relic holds no state and needs no reset
guards.rationale: RegalPillow.cs has no fields; `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-reset` puts regal_pillow in the 'relics holding no state at all' bucket, so PROMPT.md bug class 13 has nothing to bite. Recorded so the absence is visibly a source property. Also checked and absent: no IsAllowed override (so sweep B's 17-relic TotalFloor < 41 cluster does not include it) and no upon-pickup effect, which keeps the relic tradable on both sides.
